---
title: "Research"
---

My research is in probability and stochastic analysis, with a particular focus on directed polymers, stochastic partial differential equations, and the KPZ universality class.

## Research Interests

- Directed polymers in random environments
- Stochastic heat equation and Parabolic Anderson model
- KPZ universality
- Intermediate disorder for directed polymers
- Wiener chaos and stochastic analysis
